rounds.hypothesis: Merged stdout and stderr at exact cap
rounds.repro: Child writes ab to stdout and cd to stderr; cap=4
rounds.test: bounded process captures merged stdout and stderr at the exact byte cap
rounds.expected: Exact abcd bytes

rounds.repro: Child writes json to stdout and warning to stderr
rounds.test: bounded process stdout-only capture never admits stderr into protocol bytes
rounds.expected: Only json reaches stdout-only protocol

rounds.repro: Child writes five bytes with a four-byte cap
rounds.test: bounded process rejects cap plus one without publishing a prefix
rounds.expected: OutputTooLarge; no accepted partial output

rounds.repro: Relative executable, missing executable, zero budget, exit 7, SIGTERM
rounds.test: bounded process rejects nonzero and signaled terminal status
rounds.expected: Preserve distinct existing rejection expectations

rounds.repro: Child starts a TERM-ignoring descendant and closes leader output
rounds.test: bounded process timeout kills a descendant that retains the capture pipe
rounds.expected: TimedOut and bounded process-group cleanup

rounds.repro: Replace environment with the test allowlist
rounds.test: bounded process can replace inherited environment exactly
rounds.expected: Only supplied environment appears

rounds.repro: Create a non-CLOEXEC ambient descriptor
rounds.test: bounded process closes ambient descriptors when no inheritance is requested
rounds.expected: Child cannot observe it

rounds.repro: Execute from an open directory descriptor
rounds.test: bounded process binds one directory as child cwd without mutating parent authority
rounds.expected: Child cwd matches held directory; parent authority unchanged

rounds.repro: Rename or replace pathname ancestor after holding directory
rounds.test: bounded process executes a leaf from the held directory after pathname ancestor replacement
rounds.expected: Held executable leaf still executes

rounds.repro: Provide one open regular file as stdin
rounds.test: bounded process streams one held regular fd as exact child stdin
rounds.expected: Child receives exact intended input

rounds.repro: Classify ACCES, SRCH, INTR, PERM and INVAL
rounds.test: bounded process treats a child that exits before setpgid as grouped
rounds.expected: Keep established/retry/failure distinctions; pure classifier control

rounds.repro: Lower NOFILE to 256 and attempt missing child execution
rounds.test: bounded process keeps the child status when a low descriptor limit opens the setpgid race
rounds.expected: Existing ChildFailed contract retained

rounds.repro: Child emits receipt and remains alive
rounds.test: bounded inherited pipe reads a receipt before terminating a still-live GUI child
rounds.expected: Read exact receipt before explicit terminate and reap

rounds.repro: Receipt timeout and overflow
rounds.test: bounded inherited pipe preserves cleanup authority after timeout and overflow
rounds.expected: Retain authority to terminate and close descriptor

rounds.repro: Use copied inherited-pipe owner and ambient descriptors
rounds.test: bounded inherited pipe rejects copied owners and closes every ambient descriptor
rounds.expected: Reject copied owner; no unintended inheritance

rounds.repro: Exchange receipt and cleanup over inherited fd 3
rounds.test: bounded inherited socket exchanges framed receipt and cleanup before graceful exit
rounds.expected: Exact framed protocol and graceful exit

rounds.repro: Copied socket owner and invalid/oversized frame
rounds.test: bounded inherited socket rejects copied owner and retains cleanup after hostile frame
rounds.expected: Reject invalid operation while preserving cleanup

rounds.repro: Child writes distinct stdout/stderr and exits nonzero
rounds.test: bounded observation separates stdout and stderr and preserves nonzero exit
rounds.expected: Observe both streams and actual nonzero exit

rounds.repro: Child produces 20000 bytes on both stdout and stderr
rounds.test: bounded observation drains both pipes under concurrent backpressure
rounds.expected: Drain both streams without deadlock or loss

rounds.repro: SIGTERM child and nonexistent executable
rounds.test: bounded observation preserves signal and child-side exec failure
rounds.expected: Preserve signal status and existing exec-failure observation

rounds.repro: Exceed stdout cap or stderr cap separately
rounds.test: bounded observation rejects either stream cap plus one
rounds.expected: Reject either stream overflow

rounds.repro: Descendant keeps stdout or stderr pipe open
rounds.test: bounded observation timeout kills descendants retaining either pipe
rounds.expected: Bounded timeout with descendant cleanup

rounds.repro: Closed environment plus ambient descriptor
rounds.test: bounded observation replaces environment and closes ambient descriptors
rounds.expected: Only allowed environment and descriptors survive

rounds.hypothesis: Aliased buffers and repeated descriptor use
rounds.repro: Overlapping output buffers then repeated valid observations
rounds.test: bounded observation rejects aliased buffers and repeated runs leak no descriptors
rounds.expected: Reject aliasing; repeated valid calls do not leak descriptors
